name: @fleox/agentphoto
description: The photo studio your AI agent can run: retouch, layers, masks, background removal, subject cutout, filters and looks as a non-destructive JSON document, previewed headless and exported as PNG / JPEG / WebP. With a Studio to finish by hand. No server, no account.

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:studio && npm run build:agent && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.check:hermes: node scripts/build-hermes.mjs --check && python3 -m unittest discover -s hermes/tests
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/build-hermes.mjs && node scripts/build-cli-docs.mjs && git add -A plugin hermes .claude-plugin README.md AGENTS.md docs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:skills
